posts.zh:
dsh-chinese-mode 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。全局中文模式：输入框旁的紧凑胶囊开关，开启后向任意预设（完整 persona 除外）的系统提示注入语言要求；回复、思考、工具区域可分别切换中英文，并兼容锚定预设。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a102325bcdf2db4e35d9.html
posts.en:
dsh-chinese-mode is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Global Chinese mode: a compact pill switch beside the composer that injects a language requirement into any preset's system prompt (complete personas excepted); reply, thinking and tool output each toggle between Chinese and English, and anchored presets are supported.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a102325bcdf2db4e35d9.html
